evaluation_procedure_001.answer: Attachment to Letter of Transmittal; partial procedure described (focuses on administrator's joint observation/assessment role), with reference to Article 41 for detailed coach procedures.
evaluation_procedure_001.evidence: This Attachment stipulates the role of the site administrator and/or principal in the review/evaluation of first year teachers, and of tenured teachers, participating in the PAR program... A detailed description of the coach’s role can be found in Article 41, Peer Assistance and Review, of the UESF Teachers Contract.

evaluation_system_002.answer: Peer Assistance and Review (PAR) Program; San Francisco Teaching Standards (Standards 1-6)
evaluation_system_002.evidence: The Peer Assistance and Review (PAR) Program... Standards 1-6 of the San Francisco Teaching Standards.

evaluation_observation_count_003.answer: Four formal assessments per year (includes joint formal classroom observation and pre/post-observation conferences)
evaluation_observation_count_003.evidence: This is part of the four formal assessments of PT performance and growth that occur during the year.

evaluation_ratings_005.answer: satisfactory performance; below standard; Not Meeting Standards
